newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil appoints new health minister.
newsitem.headline: Brazil appoints new health minister.

text.p: A leading doctor was named Brazil's new health minister on Wednesday, a presidential spokeswoman said.

Carlos Albuquerque, a member of the government's National Health Council since 1992 and the director of a medicine faculty of Rio Grande do Sul University, was appointed to the cabinet by President Fernando Henrique Cardoso, the spokeswoman said.
Albuquerque's appointment comes a month after the resignation of his predecessor, Adib Jatene, who quit because of differences over funding with the government's economic team.
